entities.name: Mohammad Hussain Sarahang
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohammad Hussain Sarāhang was an Afghan ghazal singer and an exponent of Indian classical music from Kabul, Afghanistan. He is popularly known with the honorific Ustad Sarahang and has been renowned as the "crown of Afghanistan’s music".
